targets.query: from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "gateway" and r.tag == "voltage") |> filter(fn:(r) => r._field == "value")
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "gateway" and r.tag == "current") |> filter(fn:(r) => r._field == "value")
from(bucket:"telemetry") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "gateway" and r._field == "value") |> keep(columns:["device"]) |> group() |> distinct(column:"device") |> count()
